notes: A Friends page: everyone you play with, whether they are around, which games they have ready and their link, in one place.
Tonight on Games: a game night near starts with one press and tells your friends, under a row of things to do.
The sidebar fits any window, Settings save the moment you change them, and everyday changes come with Undo.
What this PC can run, Fenrir's icon in the system tray, and Network & Cloud says in one line how friends reach you.
